'''Thichis Kuras''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

A native of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] and a member of one of the planet's lesser noble families, Thichis Kuras was appointed a Moff by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] as the Empire required an individual who could balance the various needs of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], the independent-minded [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] nobility, and the increased industrial starship production and ordnance research.<ref name="TFUCG" />

As anti-Imperial activity increased during his reign, Moff Kuras began to crack down hard on violators. He created and enforced new military protocols, enlarged the security force, and supported the anti-insurgency work of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] and [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]].<ref name="TFUCG" />
